correctness.rationale: For a specified coverer–covered pair each external vertex has exactly three equiprobable, conditionally independent orientation patterns. The exact conditional score count is multinomial. Counting all two-cover events by shared coverer, shared covered, chain and disjoint endpoints shows S2/EW=O(n(5/6)^n+n^2(3/4)^n), supporting TV comparison of conditioning-on-existence versus size-biased marked conditioning. The multinomial CLT and binomial concentration for other degrees establish extremes. Standalone exact checker run from actual packaged paths passes 222 assertions for n=3..6; finite evidence is not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Provides a complete, exponentially accurate description of rare exceptions to universal kingship and proves that the excluded alternative and its covering witness are recoverable merely as minimum and maximum Copeland scores, respectively. It gives explicit nontrivial fluctuation covariance under rare-event conditioning, moving beyond previously known probability of exceptional tournaments.
